input_message.description: The complete research brief. The agent is autonomous and asks no follow‑up questions, so include the whole task in one message.

mode.description: Agent depth. `pro` (~20 papers) for almost all requests; `deep` (~50 papers, structured report) requires a paid plan.

filters.description: Global filters applied to every search the agent runs.

attachments.description: Scope the research to specific papers/collections.

skill.description: Run a named research workflow (a Skill) instead of the agent's open‑ended plan. Requires `mode` `deep`.
